snippet.title: Alden's Workshop
snippet.description:
Practical notes from a working harbor in Midcoast Maine. Cummins 6BTA marine diesel, lobster gear, knots, and shed work. Recorded on an older phone in the wheelhouse and the back shed. Posted when there is time and not before.

No schedule. No music. No paid promotion.

If something here saves you a tow back to the dock, fair trade.

Questions: alden.croft.me@gmail.com
